replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, sometimes. When dealing with complex equations or abstract concepts, I feel anxious because it's not my strong suit. My low openness to new ideas and low conscientiousness make it hard to engage deeply. Even simple problems can stress me out.
